changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedRelationship') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedRelationship]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [IntersectID] [int] NULL, [FromHierarchy] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedRelationship_FromHierarchy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [HierarchyIntersectID] [int] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [Cascade] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedRelationship_Cascade] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionDeletedRelationship] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC ) ) END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectID') begin ALTER TABLE api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship add SubjectID bigint null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectID') begin ALTER TABLE api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship add ObjectID bigint null end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectID') begin ALTER TABLE api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship drop column SubjectID end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectID') begin ALTER TABLE api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship drop column ObjectID end
